facts.value: a.) True, mass is always constant for a body. b.) False, the SI unit of mass is Kilograms.

Mass is a quantity that represents the amount of matter in a particle or an object. Everything we see around us has mass and all objects are light or heavy because of their mass. The SI unit of mass is kilograms.

The mass of an object can be measured using any ordinary balance. It can also be calculated using the formula, Mass = volume × density. Other formulas include Mass = Force ÷ Acceleration and Mass = Weight ÷ Gravitational Acceleration.
